<module id="div_8bit">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A 1-bit input signal indicating that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <input id="res_ready">A 1-bit input signal indicating that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">A 1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The 16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">1'b1</parameter>
        <parameter id="IDLE">1'b0</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="next_state" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        
        <reg id="res_valid_reg" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="res_ready_reg" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="sign_reg" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="opn_valid_reg" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="start_cnt" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="cnt" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="neg_divisor" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="dividend_reg" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="divisor_reg" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="remainder" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="quotient" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="SR" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="MUX_out" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
        <reg id="CARRY_OUT" type="enum" enum_id="FSM_state" init_value="IDLE"/>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State machine for controlling the division operation
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if(rst)begin
                state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                state <= next_state;
            end
        end
        
        // Next state logic
        always @(*) begin
            case(state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if(opn_valid && !res_valid)begin
                        next_state = DIVIDE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                DIVIDE: begin
                    if(cnt == 8)begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = DIVIDE;
                    end
                end
                default: next_state = IDLE;
            endcase
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for managing the division operation
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if(rst)begin
                res_valid_reg <= 0;
                res_ready_reg <= 0;
                sign_reg <= 0;
                opn_valid_reg <= 0;
                start_cnt <= 0;
                cnt <= 0;
                neg_divisor <= 0;
                dividend_reg <= 0;
                divisor_reg <= 0;
                remainder <= 0;
                quotient <= 0;
                SR <= 0;
                MUX_out <= 0;
                CARRY_OUT <= 0;
            end else begin
                case(next_state)
                    IDLE: begin
                        res_valid_reg <= 0;
                        res_ready_reg <= 0;
                        sign_reg <= sign;
                        opn_valid_reg <= opn_valid;
                        start_cnt <= 0;
                        cnt <= 0;
                        neg_divisor <= ~(|divisor + 1);
                        dividend_reg <= dividend;
                        divisor_reg <= divisor;
                        remainder <= 0;
                        quotient <= 0;
                        SR <= {dividend[7], dividend} << 1;
                    end
                    DIVIDE: begin
                        if(cnt[7])begin
                            cnt <= 0;
                            start_cnt <= 0;
                            SR <= {remainder, quotient};
                        end else begin
                            cnt <= cnt + 1;
                            start_cnt <= 1;
                            remainder <= SR[15:8];
                            quotient <= SR[7:0];
                            SR <= {MUX_out, SR[7:1]};
                        end
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic for calculating the remainder and quotient
        always @(*) begin
            if(start_cnt)begin
                if(CARRY_OUT)begin
                    MUX_out = remainder + neg_divisor;
                    CARRY_OUT = MUX_out[8];
                end else begin
                    MUX_out = remainder;
                    CARRY_OUT = 0;
                end
            end else begin
                MUX_out = remainder;
                CARRY_OUT = 0;
            end
        end
        
        // Output assignment
        assign res_valid = res_valid_reg;
        assign result = {remainder, quotient};
    </implementation>
    
    <task>
        <description></description>
    </task>
</module>
